title: Определители: each / every, either / neither, all / whole, none / no

why: Эти слова отвечают на вопрос «сколько?» и «кто именно?»: каждый, любой из двух, ни один, весь. В русском мы часто говорим просто «каждый» или «весь», а в английском выбор слова зависит от того, сколько предметов (два или больше) и в каком числе стоит существительное.
formation: • each / every + существительное в единственном числе + глагол в единственном числе: Every student has a laptop.
• each of / every one of + the / my / these + множественное число + глагол в ед. числе: Each of the rooms has a window.
• either / neither — только про ДВА предмета: either of the two options; neither of them. Neither уже отрицательное, второе отрицание не нужно.
• all + мн. число или неисчисляемое: all people, all money; all of the / all my + сущ.
• whole = «целый», стоит после the / my / a и с исчисляемым в ед. числе: the whole day, my whole family.
• no + существительное: no time. none (of) = «ни один / никто», без существительного или с of: none of the files.
usage: 1. Each — каждый по отдельности, every — все без исключения (3 и больше): Each child got a gift. (Каждый ребёнок получил подарок.) Every developer here uses Git. (Все разработчики здесь используют Git.)
2. Either — любой из двух или оба: You can sit on either side. (Можно сесть с любой стороны.)
3. Neither — ни тот, ни другой: Neither of the answers is correct. (Ни один из двух ответов не верен.) Neither tea nor coffee works for me.
4. All и whole: I worked all day = I worked the whole day. (Я работал весь день.) The whole team came. (Пришла вся команда.)
5. No и none: There is no milk. (Молока нет.) None of my friends knows. (Никто из моих друзей не знает.)
signalWords: both / either / neither (два предмета); three or more → none, any, every; the whole + ед. число; all + мн. число.
mistakes: ✗ Every students has a badge → ✓ Every student has a badge (после every — только единственное число).
✗ I worked the all day → ✓ I worked all day / the whole day (all и the whole вместе не ставим).
✗ I don't know neither of them → ✓ I don't know either of them (двойное отрицание в английском не используется).
✗ None student came → ✓ No student came / None of the students came (none без of не стоит перед существительным).
✗ Each of the employee has a laptop → ✓ Each of the employees has a laptop (после of — множественное число).
remember: Every / each + единственное число, either / neither — только для двух, whole — после the, none — без существительного (none of ...), no — с существительным.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящее слово (each, every, all, whole, no, none, either, neither)

items.prompt: ___ student in the class has a laptop.
I've been working ___ day.
There are two buttons, but ___ of them works.
I asked ten people, but ___ of them knew the answer.
We have ___ time left. It's already midnight.
You can pay by card or in cash. ___ way is fine.
He ate the ___ pizza by himself.
___ my colleagues are friendly.
(a) Every of (b) Each of the developers has a separate desk.
Each of the rooms (a) have (b) has a view of the sea.
I read the (a) all (b) whole book in one night.
(a) No (b) None of the emails were important.
I don't like (a) either (b) neither of these two laptops.
(a) Every (b) All people in my team speak English.
She has two sisters. (a) Neither (b) None of them lives in the UK.
The (a) whole (b) all family went to the beach.
No students passed the test. (Use: None of ...)
items.answer: None of the students passed the test.

items.prompt: He doesn't like tea and he doesn't like coffee. (Use: neither ... nor)
items.answer: He likes neither tea nor coffee.

items.prompt: I spent all the day at the airport. (Use: whole)
items.answer: I spent the whole day at the airport.

items.prompt: Each child got a present. (Use: Every)
I haven't seen either of the films. (Use: neither)
items.answer: I have seen neither of the films. / I've seen neither of the films.

items.prompt: There isn't any milk in the fridge. (Use: no)
items.answer: There is no milk in the fridge.

items.prompt: Every employee received an email. (Begin with: All)
items.answer: All the employees received an email. / All employees received an email.

items.prompt: The entire team worked on the project. (Use: whole)
items.answer: The whole team worked on the project.

items.prompt: Every students has a badge.
I worked the all night.
items.answer: I worked all night. / I worked the whole night.

items.prompt: None student came to the meeting.
items.answer: No student came to the meeting. / None of the students came to the meeting.

items.prompt: I don't know neither of them.
items.answer: I don't know either of them. / I know neither of them.

items.prompt: Each of the employee has a laptop.
items.answer: Each of the employees has a laptop.

items.prompt: There were three candidates, but neither of them was suitable.
items.answer: There were three candidates, but none of them was suitable.

items.prompt: I lost my all money.
Everyone have finished the test.
Каждый разработчик в нашей команде работает удалённо.
items.answer: Every developer on our team works remotely. / Each developer on our team works remotely.

items.prompt: Я проработал весь день и очень устал.
items.answer: I worked all day and I'm very tired. / I worked the whole day and I'm very tired.

items.prompt: Ни один из двух вариантов мне не нравится.
items.answer: I don't like either of the two options. / I like neither of the two options.

items.prompt: У нас нет времени.
items.answer: We have no time. / We don't have any time.

items.prompt: Никто из моих коллег не знает ответа.
items.answer: None of my colleagues knows the answer. / None of my colleagues know the answer.

items.prompt: Все мои друзья любят путешествовать.
Можно оплатить любым из двух способов.
items.answer: You can pay either way. / You can pay in either of the two ways.

items.prompt: Он потратил все свои деньги на новый ноутбук.
items.answer: He spent all his money on a new laptop.
